part_b.name: never-responds
part_b.rule: frequency 1 in week 12 and never increases

part_b.name: responsive-then-silent
part_b.rule: no decrease decided in weeks 1-7 and frequency 1 in week 12

part_b.name: silent-then-responsive
part_b.rule: no increase decided in weeks 1-7 and at least one increase decided in weeks 8-12

part_b.name: alternating
part_b.rule: at most one direction reversal and no increase after a silent last-4 window

part_b.name: prefers-minimum
part_b.rule: frequency 1 in week 12 and at most one direction reversal
